scope: The Codex and Claude inert adapter families share one host-neutral contract; host-only surfaces are enumerated rather than silently treated as parity gaps.

capabilities.codex: validated closed request with bounded untrusted text
capabilities.claude: validated closed request with bounded untrusted text

capabilities.codex: out-of-band host digest, binding, and validity window
capabilities.claude: out-of-band host digest, binding, product, and validity window

capabilities.codex: canonical bytes, manifest, bundle, and rollback digests
capabilities.claude: canonical bytes, manifest, bundle, and rollback digests

capabilities.codex: single owner-visible final hop with duplicate and required-stop guards
capabilities.claude: single owner-visible final hop with duplicate and required-stop guards

hostSpecificSurfaces.reason: Codex project-local inert templates; no Claude settings merge.
Claude host identity is an additional admission fact.
Claude Code has a settings merge surface; Codex does not.
Claude settings paths need an explicit user-level path boundary.
Codex Stop payloads use a different host contract; this adapter shares the Claude pact file and pure decider, emits the Codex decision response, and fails open on missing facts.

residuals.note: Both V1 families remain inert; live host activation requires separate governed flows.
Generated activation commands use the host PATH to resolve node; the existing host proofs disclose rather than close this residual.
The inert Claude fragment accepts only the project-local .claude/tcrn-workflow namespace.
ssh-write-observer sees Claude PreToolUse/Bash command payloads; Codex App Server execution collection is read-only and does not invoke it. No Codex execution is treated as safe by default.
STORY-193 records one digest-bound generated-handler subprocess fire and an engine activation-record receipt; current Codex Desktop load/approval/fire remains unclaimed.
